urlText: Bankstown Central development works - temporary bus stop closures
content:
Temporary bus stop closures from 4am Wednesday 6 November 2024 to 4am Sunday 6 July 2025, development work at Bankstown Central will result in the following bus stop closures:
  • Bus stop Bankstown Central, The Appain Way, Stand E (2200361) will close: o The alternative stop for the 960 towards Sutherland will be Bankstown Station, North Terrace, Stand H (2200157).
    • The 960 services that normally terminate at this stop will terminate at bus stop Bankstown Central, The Mall, Stand D (2200385).
    • Special event services towards Olympic Park will use bus stop Bankstown Central, Link Rd, Stand A (220012).
    • Special event services towards Sutherland will use bus stop Bankstown Central, the Mall, Stand C (2200384).
  • Bus stop Bankstown Central, The Mall, Stand B (220039) will close. The alternative stop will be Bankstown Central, Link Rd, Stand A (220012) for the 907, 908, 909, 911, 912, 920, M90 and M91 services towards Bankstown.
